name: Anna Tuthill

relationships.evidence: Akerly: Henry Tuthill (b. before 1715, d. 1793) m. 1738 Phoebe Horton; 'Henry's grand-da., Anna Symmes, m. President Wm. Henry Harrison'. Anna Tuthill is the daughter through whom that descent runs.

bioAdditions: Her descent, step by step from Akerly (S1): John Tuthill (1635-1717) -> Henry Tuthill 'the Justice' (b. 1 May 1665, d. 1750, m. Bethia Horton, dau. of Capt. Jonathan Horton & Bethia Wells) -> Henry (b. 1690, d. 1775, m. 1st Hannah, d. 1715) -> Henry (b. before Dec 1715, d. 17 Sep 1793, m. 16 Mar 1738 Phoebe Horton, dau. of Caleb, son of Caleb, son of Caleb, son of Barnabas Horton) -> Anna. She is therefore 4 generations below John Tuthill (1635), John's 12th-great-grandfather: 3C8R. She descends from William Wells (John's 11th-great-grandfather) through Bethia Wells -> Bethia Horton: 3C8R by that route too, and twice from Barnabas Horton (see openQuestionsNew).

openQuestionsNew: Barnabas Horton route: Anna's mother Phoebe Horton (Caleb-Caleb-Caleb-Barnabas) and grandmother Bethia Horton (Jonathan-Barnabas) both descend from Barnabas Horton, whom Round 3 places 13 generations above John via Rachel Browne (probable, compiled). If that holds, Anna is also a 4C9R twice over through Barnabas Horton.
